Contains the heap-backed framebuffer implementation for the SH8601 AMOLED display.\n\nuse alloc::boxed::Box;\nuse embedded_graphics::pixelcolor::{PixelColor, Rgb888};\nuse embedded_graphics::prelude::RgbColor;\nuse embedded_graphics_framebuf::backends::FrameBufferBackend;\nuse embedded_graphics_framebuf::FrameBuf;\n\nuse crate::config::{LCD_BUFFER_SIZE, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES};\n\n/// Heap-allocated buffer for framebuffer storage.\n///\n/// This allows allocating the large framebuffer on PSRAM instead of stack.\npub struct HeapBuffer&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt;(Box&lt;[C; N]&gt;);\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; HeapBuffer&lt;C, N&gt; {\n    pub fn new(data: Box&lt;[C; N]&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        Self(data)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; core::ops::Deref for HeapBuffer&lt;C, N&gt; {\n    type Target = [C; N];\n    fn deref(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;Self::Target {\n        &amp;self.0\n    }\n}\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; core::ops::DerefMut for HeapBuffer&lt;C, N&gt; {\n    fn deref_mut(&amp;mut self) -&gt; &amp;mut Self::Target {\n        &amp;mut self.0\n    }\n}\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; FrameBufferBackend for HeapBuffer&lt;C, N&gt; {\n    type Color = C;\n    fn set(&amp;mut self, index: usize, color: Self::Color) {\n        self.0[index] = color;\n    }\n    fn get(&amp;self, index: usize) -&gt; Self::Color {\n        self.0[index]\n    }\n    fn nr_elements(&amp;self) -&gt; usize {\n        N\n    }\n}\n\n/// Type alias for the framebuffer backing store.\npub type FbBuffer = HeapBuffer&lt;Rgb888, LCD_BUFFER_SIZE&gt;;\n\n/// Type alias for the complete framebuffer type.\npub type MyFrameBuf = FrameBuf&lt;Rgb888, FbBuffer&gt;;\n\n/// Framebuffer wrapper.\npub struct FrameBufferResource {\n    pub frame_buf: MyFrameBuf,\n}\n\nimpl FrameBufferResource {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let fb_data: Box&lt;[Rgb888; LCD_BUFFER_SIZE]&gt; = Box::new([Rgb888::BLACK; LCD_BUFFER_SIZE]);\n        let heap_buffer = HeapBuffer::new(fb_data);\n        let frame_buf = MyFrameBuf::new(heap_buffer, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES);\n        Self { frame_buf }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for FrameBufferResource {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "rust"
  }

    "content": "//! Performance tracking and metrics.\n//!\n//! Provides frame timing measurement and FPS tracking for games and applications.\n\n/// Resource for tracking frame timing and performance metrics.\n///\n/// Use this to measure and log FPS, frame times, and identify performance issues.\n///\n/// # Example\n/// &#96;&#96;&#96;ignore\n/// // In your main loop:\n/// let frame_start = embassy_time::Instant::now();\n/// schedule.run(&amp;mut world);\n/// let frame_time_us = frame_start.elapsed().as_micros() as u64;\n///\n/// if let Some(mut perf) = world.get_resource_mut::&lt;PerformanceMetrics&gt;() {\n///     perf.record_frame(frame_time_us);\n///     if perf.should_log(300) {  // Log every 300 frames\n///         perf.log_performance();\n///     }\n/// }\n/// &#96;&#96;&#96;\npub struct PerformanceMetrics {\n    /// Number of frames recorded since last reset\n    pub frame_count: u32,\n    /// Total frame time in microseconds since last reset\n    pub total_frame_time_us: u64,\n    /// Maximum frame time recorded since last reset\n    pub max_frame_time_us: u64,\n    /// Minimum frame time recorded since last reset\n    pub min_frame_time_us: u64,\n    /// Frame counter for logging interval tracking\n    pub last_log_frame: u32,\n    /// Whether to display FPS on screen (for future use)\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub show_on_screen: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for PerformanceMetrics {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            frame_count: 0,\n            total_frame_time_us: 0,\n            max_frame_time_us: 0,\n            min_frame_time_us: u64::MAX,\n            last_log_frame: 0,\n            show_on_screen: true,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl PerformanceMetrics {\n    /// Create a new PerformanceMetrics instance.\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    /// Record a frame's timing.\n    ///\n    /// Call this once per frame with the frame time in microseconds.\n    pub fn record_frame(&amp;mut self, frame_time_us: u64) {\n        self.frame_count += 1;\n        self.total_frame_time_us += frame_time_us;\n        if frame_time_us &gt;   "contentsAfterEdit": "//! Snake game logic implemented without ECS.\n//!\n//! The module keeps the game behavior identical to the former Bevy-based\n//! version while using lightweight structs suitable for &#96;no_std&#96; on ESP32.\n\nuse core::fmt::Write;\nuse embedded_graphics::pixelcolor::Rgb888;\nuse esp_hal::rng::Rng;\nuse heapless::Vec;\n\nuse crate::config::{\n    AXP2101_ADDR, AXP2101_INTSTS2, AXP2101_PKEY_SHORT_IRQ_BIT, CELL_SIZE, GRID_HEIGHT,\n    GRID_OFFSET_X, GRID_OFFSET_Y, GRID_WIDTH, HOLD_TO_RESTART_FRAMES, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES,\n};\nuse crate::hardware::{Axp2101Resource, ButtonLeftResource};\n\nconst MAX_SEGMENTS: usize = 256;\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Position {\n    pub x: i32,\n    pub y: i32,\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\npub enum Direction {\n    Up,\n    Down,\n    Left,\n    Right,\n}\n\nimpl Direction {\n    pub fn turn_left(self) -&gt; Self {\n        match self {\n            Direction::Up =&gt; Direction::Left,\n            Direction::Left =&gt; Direction::Down,\n            Direction::Down =&gt; Direction::Right,\n            Direction::Right =&gt; Direction::Up,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn turn_right(self) -&gt; Self {\n        match self {\n            Direction::Up =&gt; Direction::Right,\n            Direction::Right =&gt; Direction::Down,\n            Direction::Down =&gt; Direction::Left,\n            Direction::Left =&gt; Direction::Up,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]\npub enum FoodType {\n    Regular, // 10 points\n    Golden,  // 50 points\n    Special, // 100 points\n}\n\nimpl FoodType {\n    pub fn points(&amp;self) -&gt; u32 {\n        match self {\n            FoodType::Regular =&gt; 10,\n            FoodType::Golden =&gt; 50,\n            FoodType::Special =&gt; 100,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn color(&amp;self) -&gt; Rgb888 {\n        match self {\n            FoodType::Regular =&gt; Rgb888::new(255, 0, 0),\n            FoodType::Golden =&gt; Rgb888::new(255, 215, 0),\n            FoodType::Special =&gt; Rgb888::new(255, 0, 255),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn spawn_chance(&amp;self) -&gt; u32 {\n        match self {\n            FoodType::Regular =&gt; 70, // 70% chance\n            FoodType::Golden =&gt; 25,  // 25% chance\n            FoodType::Special =&gt; 5,  // 5% chance\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\npub struct Food {\n    pub food_type: FoodType,\n    pub animation_frame: u8, // For pulsing animation\n}\n\n#[derive(Clone, Copy)]\npub struct FoodEntity {\n    pub position: Position,\n    pub food: Food,\n}\n\npub struct GameState {\n    pub score: u32,\n    pub game_over: bool,\n    pub move_timer: u32,\n    pub move_interval: u32,   // frames between moves\n    pub frames_elapsed: u32,  // Track total frames to prevent immediate collision\n    pub needs_redraw: bool,   // Track if we need to redraw\n    pub new_high_score: bool, // Track if we just achieved a new high score\n}\n\nimpl Default for GameState {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            score: 0,\n            game_over: false,\n            move_timer: 0,\n            move_interval: 10, // Movement speed (frames between moves) - tuned for ~60fps target\n            frames_elapsed: 0,\n            needs_redraw: true, // Initial render needed\n            new_high_score: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\npub struct HighScore {\n    score: u32,\n    // TODO: Add flash persistence when esp-storage or similar is available\n    // For now, high score resets on reboot\n}\n\nimpl HighScore {\n    pub fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        Self { score: 0 }\n    }\n\n    pub fn update(&amp;mut self, new_score: u32) -&gt; bool {\n        if new_score &gt; self.score {\n            self.score = new_score;\n            esp_println::println!(\"NEW HIGH SCORE: {}!\", self.score);\n            true\n        } else {\n            false\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn get(&amp;self) -&gt; u32 {\n        self.score\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for HighScore {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct InputState {\n    pub turn_left: bool,\n    pub turn_right: bool,\n    pub restart: bool,\n}\n\n#[derive(Default)]\npub struct ButtonState {\n    /// Was BOOT button pressed last frame (for edge detection)\n    pub boot_was_pressed: bool,\n    /// BOOT button debounce counter\n    pub boot_debounce: u32,\n    /// Was power key pressed last frame (for edge detection)\n    pub pkey_was_pressed: bool,\n    /// Frame counter for hold-to-restart\n    pub hold_start_frame: Option&lt;u32&gt;,\n    /// Current frame number\n    pub frame: u32,\n}\n\nstruct Snake {\n    head: Position,\n    direction: Direction,\n    segments: Vec&lt;Position, MAX_SEGMENTS&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl Snake {\n    fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let mut segments: Vec&lt;Position, MAX_SEGMENTS&gt; = Vec::new();\n        segments.push(Position { x: 22, y: 28 }).ok();\n        segments.push(Position { x: 21, y: 28 }).ok();\n        Self {\n            head: Position { x: 23, y: 28 },\n            direction: Direction::Right,\n            segments,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn move_forward(&amp;mut self, game_state: &amp;mut GameState) {\n        game_state.frames_elapsed = game_state.frames_elapsed.saturating_add(1);\n        game_state.move_timer = game_state.move_timer.saturating_add(1);\n        if game_state.move_timer &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n            return;\n        }\n        game_state.move_timer = 0;\n        game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n\n        let new_head = match self.direction {\n            Direction::Up =&gt; Position {\n                x: self.head.x,\n                y: self.head.y - 1,\n            },\n            Direction::Down =&gt; Position {\n                x: self.head.x,\n                y: self.head.y + 1,\n            },\n            Direction::Left =&gt; Position {\n                x: self.head.x - 1,\n                y: self.head.y,\n            },\n            Direction::Right =&gt; Position {\n                x: self.head.x + 1,\n                y: self.head.y,\n            },\n        };\n\n        let mut prev_pos = self.head;\n        for seg in self.segments.iter_mut() {\n            core::mem::swap(seg, &amp;mut prev_pos);\n        }\n        self.head = new_head;\n    }\n\n    fn grow(&amp;mut self, position: Position) {\n        let _ = self.segments.push(position);\n    }\n\n    fn head(&amp;self) -&gt; Position {\n        self.head\n    }\n\n    fn direction(&amp;self) -&gt; Direction {\n        self.direction\n    }\n\n    fn set_direction(&amp;mut self, dir: Direction) {\n        self.direction = dir;\n    }\n\n    fn segments(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;[Position] {\n        &amp;self.segments\n    }\n}\n\npub struct Game {\n    pub state: GameState,\n    pub high_score: HighScore,\n    pub input: InputState,\n    pub button_state: ButtonState,\n    pub rng: Rng,\n    snake: Snake,\n    food: Option&lt;FoodEntity&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl Game {\n    pub fn new(rng: Rng) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            state: GameState::default(),\n            high_score: HighScore::new(),\n            input: InputState::default(),\n            button_state: ButtonState::default(),\n            rng,\n            snake: Snake::new(),\n            food: None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn poll_inputs(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        left_btn: &amp;ButtonLeftResource,\n        axp2101: &amp;mut Axp2101Resource,\n    ) {\n        self.button_state.frame = self.button_state.frame.saturating_add(1);\n\n        // BOOT button (GPIO0) - active-low\n        let boot_raw = left_btn.button.is_low();\n        let boot_pressed = if boot_raw {\n            self.button_state.boot_debounce = self.button_state.boot_debounce.saturating_add(1);\n            self.button_state.boot_debounce &gt;= 1\n        } else {\n            self.button_state.boot_debounce = 0;\n            false\n        };\n\n        let boot_just_pressed = boot_pressed &amp;&amp; !self.button_state.boot_was_pressed;\n        self.button_state.boot_was_pressed = boot_pressed;\n\n        // Power key via AXP2101\n        let pkey_pressed = {\n            let mut i2c = axp2101.i2c.borrow_mut();\n            let mut status = [0u8; 1];\n            if i2c\n                .write_read(AXP2101_ADDR, &amp;[AXP2101_INTSTS2], &amp;mut status)\n                .is_ok()\n            {\n                let short_press = (status[0] &amp; AXP2101_PKEY_SHORT_IRQ_BIT) != 0;\n                if short_press {\n                    let _ = i2c.write(AXP2101_ADDR, &amp;[AXP2101_INTSTS2, 0xFF]);\n                }\n                short_press\n            } else {\n                false\n            }\n        };\n\n        let pkey_just_pressed = pkey_pressed &amp;&amp; !self.button_state.pkey_was_pressed;\n        self.button_state.pkey_was_pressed = pkey_pressed;\n\n        let any_pressed = boot_pressed || pkey_pressed;\n\n        if self.state.game_over {\n            if any_pressed {\n                if self.button_state.hold_start_frame.is_none() {\n                    self.button_state.hold_start_frame = Some(self.button_state.frame);\n                } else if let Some(start) = self.button_state.hold_start_frame {\n                    let hold_duration = self.button_state.frame.saturating_sub(start);\n                    if hold_duration &gt;= HOLD_TO_RESTART_FRAMES &amp;&amp; !self.input.restart {\n                        self.input.restart = true;\n                        esp_println::println!(\"BTN: held long enough - restart!\");\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                self.button_state.hold_start_frame = None;\n            }\n        } else {\n            self.button_state.hold_start_frame = None;\n\n            if boot_just_pressed {\n                self.input.turn_left = true;\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: BOOT press -&gt; turn left\");\n            }\n            if pkey_just_pressed {\n                self.input.turn_right = true;\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: Power key press -&gt; turn right\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn handle_restart(&amp;mut self) {\n        if !self.input.restart {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        esp_println::println!(\"=== RESTART TRIGGERED ===\");\n        esp_println::println!(\"  game_over was: {}\", self.state.game_over);\n\n        self.input.restart = false;\n        let old_high_score_flag = self.state.new_high_score;\n        self.state = GameState::default();\n        self.state.new_high_score = old_high_score_flag;\n\n        self.snake = Snake::new();\n        self.food = None;\n        self.state.needs_redraw = true;\n    }\n\n    pub fn process_turns(&amp;mut self) {\n        if self.input.restart {\n            return;\n        }\n        if self.state.game_over {\n            self.input.turn_left = false;\n            self.input.turn_right = false;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if self.input.turn_left {\n            self.snake.set_direction(self.snake.direction().turn_left());\n            self.state.needs_redraw = true;\n            self.input.turn_left = false;\n        } else if self.input.turn_right {\n Owns core resources (game state, framebuffer, perf metrics) and runs the\n//! deterministic update → render → blit pipeline.\n\nuse crate::display::FrameBufferResource;\nuse crate::game::Game;\nuse crate::hardware::{Axp2101Resource, ButtonLeftResource, DisplayDriver};\nuse crate::perf::PerformanceMetrics;\nuse crate::render::render_game;\n\npub struct Engine {\n    pub game: Game,\n    pub framebuffer: FrameBufferResource,\n    pub perf: PerformanceMetrics,\n}\n\nimpl Engine {\n    pub fn new(game: Game, framebuffer: FrameBufferResource, perf: PerformanceMetrics) -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            game,\n            framebuffer,\n            perf,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Run one frame of input → simulation → render (if needed).\n    pub fn run_frame(\n        &amp;mut self,\n        display: &amp;mut DisplayDriver,\n        buttons: &amp;ButtonLeftResource,\n        axp2101: &amp;mut Axp2101Resource,\n    ) {\n        self.game.poll_inputs(buttons, axp2101);\n        self.game.handle_restart();\n        self.game.process_turns();\n        self.game.animate_food();\n        self.game.move_snake();\n        self.game.check_collisions();\n        self.game.spawn_food_if_needed();\n\n        if self.game.should_render() {\n            render_game(display, &amp;mut self.framebuffer.frame_buf, &amp;self.game);\n            self.game.mark_rendered();\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn record_frame_time(&amp;mut self, frame_time_us: u64) {\n        self.perf.record_frame(frame_time_us);\n    }\n}\n",
    "languageId": "rust"
  }
}

char_width: i32,\n) {\n    let x = center_text_x(text, char_width, screen_width);\n    draw_text(target, text, x, y, color, font);\n}\n\n/// Draw a formatted score string.\npub fn draw_score&lt;D: DrawTarget&lt;Color = Rgb888&gt;&gt;(\n    target: &amp;mut D,\n    label: &amp;str,\n    score: u32,\n    x: i32,\n    y: i32,\n    color: Rgb888,\n) {\n    let mut text = String::&lt;32&gt;::new();\n    write!(text, \"{}{}\", label, score).ok();\n    draw_text(target, text.as_str(), x, y, color, &amp;FONT_10X20);\n}\n\n// =============================================================================\n// Framebuffer to Display Transfer\n// =============================================================================\n\n/// Transfer framebuffer to display using run-length encoded row drawing.\n///\n/// This optimized transfer method groups identical pixels into rectangles,\n/// reducing the number of draw calls significantly for sparse displays.\npub fn transfer_framebuffer_rle&lt;D: DrawTarget&lt;Color = Rgb888&gt;&gt;(\n    display: &amp;mut D,\n    fb_data: &amp;[Rgb888],\n    width: usize,\n    height: usize,\n) {\n    for y in 0..height {\n        let row_start = y * width;\n        let mut x = 0;\n        while x &lt; width {\n            let pixel = fb_data[row_start + x];\n\n            // Find run of identical pixels\n            let start_x = x;\n            let mut end_x = x + 1;\n            while end_x &lt; width &amp;&amp; fb_data[row_start + end_x] == pixel {\n                end_x += 1;\n            }\n\n            // Draw rectangle for this run\n            let run_width = end_x - start_x;\n            Rectangle::new(\n                Point::new(start_x as i32, y as i32),\n                Size::new(run_width as u32, 1),\n            )\n            .into_styled(PrimitiveStyle::with_fill(pixel))\n            .draw(display)\n            .ok();\n\n            x = end_x;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// =============================================================================\n// Default Grid Config for this hardware\n// =============================================================================\n\n/// Create the default grid configuration for the Waveshare display.\npub const fn default_grid_config() -&gt; GridConfig {\n    GridConfig::new(\n        LCD_H_RES,\n        LCD_V_RES,\n        8, // cell size\n        0, // offset x\n        0, // offset y\n    )\n}\n\n// =============================================================================\n// Game rendering\n// =============================================================================\n\n/// Snake head color (darker green)\nconst SNAKE_HEAD_COLOR: Rgb888 = Rgb888::new(0, 200, 0);\n/// Snake body base color (bright green)\nconst SNAKE_BODY_COLOR: Rgb888 = Rgb888::new(0, 255, 0);\n\nfn render_food(fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888], config: &amp;GridConfig, food: Option&lt;&amp;FoodEntity&gt;) {\n    if let Some(food) = food {\n        draw_grid_cell_animated(\n            fb_data,\n            config,\n            food.position.x,\n            food.position.y,\n            food.food.food_type.color(),\n            food.food.animation_frame,\n        );\n    }\n}\n\nfn render_snake_segments(fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888], config: &amp;GridConfig, segments: &amp;[Position]) {\n    let total_segments = segments.len().max(1);\n\n    for (idx, pos) in segments.iter().enumerate() {\n        // Intensity ranges from 255 (head-adjacent) to 128 (tail)\n        let intensity = 128 + ((127 * (total_segments - idx)) / total_segments.max(1)) as u8;\n        draw_grid_cell_gradient(fb_data, config, pos.x, pos.y, SNAKE_BODY_COLOR, intensity);\n    }\n}\n\nfn render_snake_head(fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888], config: &amp;GridConfig, head: Position) {\n    draw_grid_cell(fb_data, config, head.x, head.y, SNAKE_HEAD_COLOR);\n}\n\nfn render_game_over_ui(\n    target: &amp;mut MyFrameBuf,\n    game_state: &amp;GameState,\n    high_score: &amp;HighScore,\n) {\n    let game_over_text = if game_state.new_high_score {\n        \"NEW HIGH SCORE!\"\n    } else {\n        \"GAME OVER\"\n    };\n\n    let center_y = LCD_V_RES as i32 / 2;\n\n    let title_color = if game_state.new_high_score {\n        colors::GOLD\n    } else {\n        colors::RED\n    };\n    draw_text_centered(\n        target,\n        game_over_text,\n        center_y - 50,\n        title_color,\n        &amp;FONT_10X20,\n        LCD_H_RES as i32,\n        10,\n    );\n\n    let mut score_text = String::&lt;20&gt;::new();\n    write!(score_text, \"Score: {}\", game_state.score).ok();\n    draw_text_centered(\n        target,\n        score_text.as_str(),\n        center_y - 20,\n        colors::WHITE,\n        &amp;FONT_10X20,\n        LCD_H_RES as i32,\n        10,\n    );\n\n    let mut high_score_text = String::&lt;30&gt;::new();\n    write!(high_score_text, \"High: {}\", high_score.get()).ok();\n    draw_text_centered(\n        target,\n        high_score_text.as_str(),\n        center_y + 10,\n        colors::GOLD,\n        &amp;FONT_10X20,\n        LCD_H_RES as i32,\n        10,\n    );\n\n    draw_text_centered(\n        target,\n        \"Hold both to restart\",\n        center_y + 40,\n        colors::GRAY,\n        &amp;FONT_10X20,\n        LCD_H_RES as i32,\n        10,\n    );\n}\n\nfn render_gameplay_ui(target: &amp;mut MyFrameBuf, game_state: &amp;GameState, high_score: &amp;HighScore) {\n    draw_score(\n        target,\n        \"Score: \",\n        game_state.score,\n        8,\n        LCD_V_RES as i32 - 40,\n        colors::WHITE,\n    );\n\n    draw_score(\n        target,\n        \"High: \",\n        high_score.get(),\n        8,\n        LCD_V_RES as i32 - 20,\n        colors::GOLD,\n    );\n\n    draw_text(\n        target,\n        \"Boot=Left Pwr=Right\",\n        8,\n        8,\n        colors::GRAY,\n        &amp;FONT_10X20,\n    );\n}\n\n/// Render the current frame to the framebuffer and flush to the display.\npub fn render_game(display: &amp;mut DisplayDriver, fb: &amp;mut MyFrameBuf, game: &amp;Game) {\n    fb.clear(Rgb888::BLACK).unwrap();\n\n    let config = GridConfig::new(\n        LCD_H_RES,\n        LCD_V_RES,\n        CELL_SIZE as usize,\n        GRID_OFFSET_X,\n        GRID_OFFSET_Y,\n    );\n\n    let fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888] = &amp;mut *fb.data;\n\n    render_food(fb_data, &amp;config, game.food());\n    render_snake_segments(fb_data, &amp;config, game.segments());\n    render_snake_head(fb_data, &amp;config, game.head());\n\n    if game.state.game_over {\n        render_game_over_ui(fb, &amp;game.state, &amp;game.high_score);\n    } else {\n        render_gameplay_ui(fb, &amp;game.state, &amp;game.high_score);\n    }\n\n    let fb_data: &amp;[Rgb888] = &amp;*fb.data;\n    transfer_framebuffer_rle(display, fb_data, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES);\n    display.flush().ok();\n}\n"

N]&gt;);\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; HeapBuffer&lt;C, N&gt; {\n    pub fn new(data: Box&lt;[C; N]&gt;) -&gt; Self {\n        Self(data)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl&lt;C: PixelColor, const N: usize&gt; Refactored to a lightweight, no-ECS game loop tailored for ESP32 while keeping behavior intact. Key pieces:
- New `Engine` drives input → simulation → render/blit, owning framebuffer and perf metrics; one call per frame handles input polling, movement, collision, spawn, and conditional render.  
```12:45:src/engine.rs
pub struct Engine {
    pub game: Game,
    pub framebuffer: FrameBufferResource,
    pub perf: PerformanceMetrics,
}
...
pub fn run_frame(&mut self, display: &mut DisplayDriver, buttons: &ButtonLeftResource, axp2101: &mut Axp2101Resource) {
    self.game.poll_inputs(buttons, axp2101);
    self.game.handle_restart();
    self.game.process_turns();
    self.game.animate_food();
    self.game.move_snake();
    self.game.check_collisions();
    self.game.spawn_food_if_needed();
    if self.game.should_render() {
        render_game(display, &mut self.framebuffer.frame_buf, &self.game);
        self.game.mark_rendered();
    }
}
```
- Game logic rewritten to plain structs: button edge detection with hold-to-restart, movement with gradient-friendly segment order, collision/food handling, and redraw hints preserved.  
```248:378:src/game.rs
pub struct Game { pub state: GameState, pub high_score: HighScore, pub input: InputState, pub button_state: ButtonState, pub rng: Rng, snake: Snake, food: Option<FoodEntity>, }
...
pub fn poll_inputs(&mut self, left_btn: &ButtonLeftResource, axp2101: &mut Axp2101Resource) { /* BOOT + PWR handling + hold-to-restart */ }
...
pub fn check_collisions(&mut self) { /* walls/self, scoring, growth, speed boost */ }
```
- Renderer now consumes the new state directly and keeps the same visuals/HUD, clearing the framebuffer and RLE-blitting to the SH8601 driver.  
```493:519:src/render.rs
pub fn render_game(display: &mut DisplayDriver, fb: &mut MyFrameBuf, game: &Game) {
    fb.clear(Rgb888::BLACK).unwrap();
    let config = GridConfig::new(LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES, CELL_SIZE as usize, GRID_OFFSET_X, GRID_OFFSET_Y);
    let fb_data: &mut [Rgb888] = &mut *fb.data;
    render_food(fb_data, &config, game.food());
    render_snake_segments(fb_data, &config, game.segments());
    render_snake_head(fb_data, &config, game.head());
    if game.state.game_over { render_game_over_ui(fb, &game.state, &game.high_score); } else { render_gameplay_ui(fb, &game.state, &game.high_score); }
    transfer_framebuffer_rle(display, fb_data, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES);
    display.flush().ok();
}
```
- `main` now wires hardware into the engine loop (no Bevy), keeps frame pacing and perf logging.
